Chapter 683: Chapter 15: Breakthrough Preparation (Subscribe Request)_2

“`

It was one thing to rely on the protection of the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being during ordinary times.

But to rely on the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being even during the critical moment of breaking through from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank?

Xia Qin Supreme Being felt somewhat that it was not quite proper.

After all, Lin Yuan’s breakthrough was not a long process, and sending an incarnation wouldn’t takes much effort.

“Thank you, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan expressed his gratitude.

...

To be personally protected by a Supreme Being during his breakthrough? Such an honor in human civilization, probably only afforded to those making the leap from Tier 11 to Twelfth Rank.

Yet, Lin Yuan, in breaking through from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank, had already enjoyed it; Xia Qin Supreme Being’s regard for him was evident.

However, given the potential Lin Yuan had already displayed, in terms of importance, it was no less than that of human civilization’s Eleventh Rank Peak Evolvers.

Even in the eyes of the Supreme Being, he was considerably stronger.

For a Supreme Being, the difference between Ninth Rank and Eleventh Rank was actually not that significant.

What mattered was the potential and possibility to step into Twelfth Rank.

So far, Lin Yuan’s performance in this aspect was better than those Eleventh Rank Peak Evolvers.

To be bathed in the Chaos Void Origin’s nurture when breaking through from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank, and then from Tenth Rank to Tier 11, enjoying something only experienced when advancing from Eleventh Rank to Twelfth Rank?

It meant that when Lin Yuan stepped into Tier 11, his Physical Soul, Spirit Will, Inner World, and so on would be able to crush most Eleventh Rank Powerhouses.

Even if his Understanding of Rules wasn’t as great as those at the Eleventh Rank Peak, his own foundation would still allow him to preserve his life or even fight.

Once Lin Yuan reached the Eleventh Rank Peak, his chances of making the ultimate breakthrough were much higher compared to other Eleventh Rank Peak entities aiming for Ultimate status.

This increase in probability was entirely due to Lin Yuan’s own merits, rather than any external factors.

And what if he had the support of human civilization, employing those few key treasures?

At the very least, Lin Yuan was the Evolver with the highest potential to reach the Ultimate level in two million years of human civilization.

Why wouldn’t such an exceptional genius be valued and kept close?

“During the breakthrough, try to reach into the deeper Spatial Layers,” Xia Qin Supreme Being finally reminded him.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

When he was breaking through from Eighth Layer to Ninth Rank.

He had not yet opened the Spatial Layers.

So he chose a desolate Star Domain to make his breakthrough in.

It was also a way to minimize the impact of the breakthrough.

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s suggestion for him to break through in the deeper Spatial Layers was approximately the same reasoning.

Lin Yuan’s impact while advancing from Eighth Layer to Ninth Rank was only a matter of tens to hundreds of light-years.

But the breakthrough from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank, not to mention other aspects, just the Inner World foundation alone was improved by more than tens of millions of times.

If he didn’t break through within the deeper Spatial Layers, the impact would be unimaginable.

And since the main source of the impact was the nourishment from the Chaos Void Origin, it wasn’t appropriate for Xia Qin Supreme Being to try and stop it.

Stop it? To halt the nourishment from the Chaos Void Origin?

Naturally, Xia Qin Supreme Being would not commit such a foolish act.

…

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared.

Xia Qin Supreme Being sat on his throne, his thoughts stirring slightly.

An incarnation appeared outside the Xia You Evolution Tower and stepped out, heading towards the Milky Way Star Region.

The Xia You Evolution Tower was incomparably far from the Milky Way Star Region, separated by light-years of distance.

But such distances, for a Supreme Being, naturally meant little.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, the main bulk of his awareness focusing on the slow metamorphosis within himself.

The transformation originated in the Inner World, gradually influencing the Physical Soul and Spirit Will.

Understanding the Rule of Time thoroughly and achieving an independent and complete Inner World had a critically important role in driving the entire transformation process.

“Twenty years.”

Even with just twenty years to go before stepping into Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan was not willing to waste time.

Instead, he reviewed the Martial Path Evolutionary Path in his mind, from the First Tier Chapter to the Ninth Rank Chapter.

Every last detail surged to the forefront of his mind.

Though Xia Qin Supreme Being put more importance on his comprehension of the Rule of Time, Lin Yuan knew clearly.

His foundation was always the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

This was the basis for everything Lin Yuan had achieved.

Reviewing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was akin to revisiting the evolutionary path he had traversed.

“Could the Martial Path Evolutionary Path be further perfected? Could it be improved upon?” Lin Yuan began from the beginning, scrutinizing every word closely.

Compared to just after completing his ninth traversal, Lin Yuan, although still at Ninth Rank, had made substantial progress.

Having understood the Rule of Time and gained control over space-time, his perception of the essence of power and rules had changed profoundly.

Now, as he looked at the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he naturally gained new insights and understandings.

“The First Tier Chapter should place more emphasis on fundamentals. The flesh is the beginning of Martial Tao, without a strong physical body, it’s difficult to reach the end of the Martial Path.”

“Second Layer Chapter…”

“Third Rank Chapter…”

…

Lin Yuan began to ‘modify’ the Martial Path Evolutionary Path bit by bit.

This modification did not involve any major changes but rather fine-tuned the subtleties, making the Martial Path Evolutionary Path more complete and perfect.

At the very least, it would reduce the confusion faced by countless Martial Dao Cultivators when practicing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, more than half a year passed.

Lin Yuan had finally reviewed the Martial Path Evolutionary Path from beginning to end once again.

First Tier Chapter, Second Layer Chapter, Third Rank Chapter, all the way up to the Ninth Rank Chapter.

“Now, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is easier for Evolvers to comprehend, and the essence it expounds is clearer,” Lin Yuan said with a smile on his face.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path was something he had created from nothing, drawing on thousands of cultivation systems and evolutionary paths to ultimately carve out his own.

As for the Martial Tao of the first world he traversed? Now, Lin Yuan’s Martial Path Evolutionary Path was already starkly different from the Martial Tao of the first world.
